slide1.headline: India's AI Funding Boom in H1 2026
slide1.subtitle: Left most startups starving

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Event date: 02 Jul 2026
India's AI funding boom in H1 2026 left most startups starving
A significant amount of funding was raised, but it didn't reach most startups
The funding boom was largely concentrated among a few large players
This has raised concerns about the sustainability of the ecosystem

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The concentration of funding among a few large players can stifle innovation
It can also lead to a lack of diversity in the ecosystem
This can have long-term consequences for the growth and development of the AI industry in India
Source: Analytics India Magazine, 02 Jul 2026

slide1.headline: EU AI Act Guidelines Released
slide1.subtitle: Draft high-risk guidelines are now available

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Event date: 02 Jul 2026
The European Union has released draft guidelines for the AI Act
The guidelines are focused on high-risk AI applications
The draft guidelines are open for comment until 23 July
The exact implications of the guidelines are not yet clear, but they are expected to have a significant impact on the AI industry

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The EU AI Act guidelines will have significant implications for the development and deployment of AI in the EU
The guidelines will impact companies that develop and deploy AI in the EU, including those that provide AI-powered services
The guidelines will also impact the broader AI ecosystem, including researchers and developers
The EU AI Act is expected to set a precedent for AI regulation globally

slide4.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: The EU AI Act guidelines are a significant development in the regulation of AI
The guidelines will have far-reaching implications for the AI industry
Companies and researchers will need to carefully review the guidelines and provide feedback
